page: Microsoft Azure L128as_v5 is a storage-optimized server instance belonging to the Lasv5 family. It is powered by an AMD processor with x86_64 architecture, offering 128 dedicated vCPUs. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance features 1024.0 GB of system memory, which translates to a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

A defining characteristic of the L128as_v5 is its local storage capacity, which provides 30718 GB of local storage. The instance is also Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance disk options. There are no integrated GPUs on this instance, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The high density of both memory and local storage on a single node provides qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require massive local scratch space or high-throughput database operations without relying on external storage networks. This hardware profile is suited for large-scale relational databases, NoSQL data stores, big data analytics, and data warehousing applications.
